in_arabic.name: Laskhar
in_arabic.long_meaning: Laskhar هو اسم عربي إسلامي يحمل معنى عميقاً في الثقافة الإسلامية. A name derived from the Arabic word 'al-asad', meaning 'lion'. It is a strong and courageous name that is often given to boys who are expected to exhibit great strength and valor in their lives.
